title: YouTube video launch
when: You are making a long-form YouTube video and want the packaging and retention right.
summary: Validate the topic, design the title and thumbnail first, script for retention, edit, upload, test, read the curve.

steps.title: Validate the topic
steps.do: Check there is search demand or outlier proof for this topic. Pick the target keyword.

steps.title: Title and thumbnail first
steps.do: Three title and thumbnail pairs. Check they do not repeat each other.

steps.title: Script for retention
steps.do: Cold open that pays off the title, open loops, a reason to stay at each dip.

steps.title: Edit plan
steps.do: Cut list, pacing notes, caption file.

steps.title: Description, chapters, tags
steps.do: First 150 characters, chapters, no more than 15 hashtags.

steps.title: Humanize and policy check
steps.do: AI disclosure toggle if the video has realistic synthetic content. Sponsorship disclosure. Music rights.

steps.title: Upload and set up Test & compare
steps.do: You upload. Set up title and thumbnail variants in Studio if you have the feature.

steps.title: Read the curve at 48 hours
steps.do: Export retention. Find the cliffs. Decide what the next video does differently.

steps.title: Log the lesson
steps.do: One line: what you changed, what happened, what you will do next.
